adjudication_rule: A claim is supported only if its cited source text entails the entire claim. Direct negation is contradicted; a source about a different fact is unsupported; ambiguous status is uncertain. Exact citation ID and quote presence are separately checked. Expected final status follows fixed host critical/dependency policy and independent semantic labels.
label_provenance: Synthetic case author adjudicated exact claim meaning against the authored passage text and host request before holdout. Scorer-only labels are separate from case and prediction files. Independent pre-result reviewer must check every label; no real-world factual verification or provider judgment is claimed.
limits_of_inference: Small authored corpus; no real retrieval, model, provider cost/latency, user history, deployment, or combined #45+#47 treatment. Only local Python elapsed time was measured.

policy.latency_cost_semantics: Fixture-assigned assessor latency/cost only; both are simulated and capped per case. Local Python elapsed time is separately measured; actual model latency and price are unknown. A timed-out, failed or late call still consumes its assigned simulated resource.
policy.rubric: registered per-claim supported, contradicted, unsupported, uncertain; assessment evidence IDs must be checked citations for that claim; semantic labels are advisory and host controls final disposition
policy.stop_rule: All fifteen new holdout cases run once in fixed order under all four arms; no early stop, no post-result tuning, and every scheduled failure remains in the denominator. Synthetic screen pass never authorizes adoption.
